article.story: SAN DIEGO -- — Jevon Hill scored 18 points and San Diego beat Chicago State 87-67 on Friday night. Hill finished 6 of 10 from 3-point range for the Toreros (3-1). Marqui Worthy added 12 points and five assists. Dusty Stromer pitched in with 10 points and three steals. Mike Price led the way for the Cougars (2-3) with 20 points. Armari Carraway scored 17 and Malik Olafioye contributed 11 points and five assists. San Diego took the lead with 16:26 left in the first half and did not trail again. Hill led with nine points in the first half to help put them up 46-29 at the break. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
